A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GenProve and ReFInE. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-E are readable and can be matched across pagination, numbering, and relocation changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original GenProve experiments on ReFInE, including model comparisons, reward ablations, training dynamics, and human evaluation.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and additionally reports GenProve's document-level citation evaluation in Section 5.3 and Table 2.

M1.justification: The SFT-plus-GRPO procedure, sentence matching, provenance reward, and composite objective remain unchanged. Expanded explanations of SFT and expert validation describe existing procedures rather than new components.

E1.justification: Both retain ReFInE and its English multi-document QA coverage. The added DocID-only comparison collapses provenance for coarser scoring; it does not establish an additional dataset, generation task, population, or input scenario.

E2.justification: v2 retains the 14 original LLM comparators and adds VANILLA, SUMM, SNIPPET, APO, VeriCite, and GERE in Table 2. This substantially extends the reported comparisons to dedicated citation and evidence methods, beyond the original general LLM comparison.

E3.justification: v2 Section 5.3 adds a protocol that collapses sentence-level provenance into document sets and reports Doc-Precision, Doc-Recall, and Doc-F1. Existing training settings, splits, and human-evaluation procedures remain unchanged. The new comparison's test data and baseline configurations are not fully specified.

E4.justification: The reward ablations, relation breakdown, training dynamics, and four qualitative failure cases are retained. The incorrect-provenance-type example moves from v1 Appendix D/Figure 18 to v2 Section 5.5/Figure 7; it is not a new analysis.

E5.justification: Both retain the same averaging of human ratings and model-level Pearson correlation analysis. Neither adds training seeds, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: v2 Table 2 adds document-level results, reporting GenProve Doc-F1 of 92.43 versus GERE's 81.10. All seven original tables retain their values, as do the existing plotted findings. The added scores concern a coarser evaluation, not a same-setting performance improvement over v1.

T1.justification: The training and reward equations (1)-(10) and Appendix A's task definitions (11)-(12) are unchanged. No new theorem, proof, derivation, or formal assumption is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: typed generation-time provenance, ReFInE, SFT-plus-GRPO training, superiority over 14 LLMs, and the difficulty of inference-based provenance.

C2.justification: v2 interprets the new document-level results as cross-granularity transfer and explicitly links reference-averaged provenance scores to broader evidence coverage rather than repetition. The stated latency, language, retrieval, and Appendix E limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a public-code availability statement and repository address in the abstract; v1 has no equivalent code link. Existing hyperparameters, annotation protocols, and inference and evaluation prompts remain unchanged. The PDFs alone do not verify repository contents.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for APO, VeriCite, MIRAGE, and BayesRAG and positions GenProve against prior document-level citation systems. The broader related-work structure and its distinction from TROVE remain intact.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized clarifications to dataset motivation, validation, SFT, and results discussion; adds a benchmark subsection and acknowledgements; and revises affiliations and contribution notes. The overall narrative and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 2, slightly enlarges Figure 4, moves the relation-type error figure into the main text, and repositions existing tables and figures. Captions, numbering, and page layout receive limited adjustments; existing displays largely retain their design.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1, v2 supplies a code location, adds a useful comparison with prior citation methods, and makes an existing failure case more prominent. These are modest gains while the original evidence remains intact. The new benchmark's incomplete protocol description limits confidence in its claimed cross-granularity transfer, so it does not establish a substantial overall improvement.
